xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3450: pan sync never prunes removed skills/rules from cache and harness dirs (beads survived removal for weeks)

plan.title: pan sync never prunes removed skills/rules from cache and harness dirs (beads survived removal for weeks)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: pan sync copies bundled skills/agents/rules into the ~/.overdeck cache and distributes them to ~/.claude/, ~/.agents/skills/, and workspace .claude/ dirs, but no stage ever deletes entries whose bundled source was removed. The PAN-2648 beads removal deleted the sources, yet beads-dolt-authority.md and the beads skills survived in every cache and target for weeks and kept being re-provisioned into agent sessions. Empty source dirs (git does not track directories) were also recreated in the cache on every sync, defeating manual cache cleanup.
narratives.Proposal: Add one shared manifest-driven prune helper (pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync) in src/lib/manifest.ts and wire it into all four copy stages: refreshCacheSync (cache vs SYNC_SOURCES), executeSyncSync (~/.claude), executeAgentSkillsSync (~/.agents/skills), and mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync (workspace .claude). An entry is pruned only when its manifest source is 'overdeck', its path is absent from the stage's source set, and its on-disk hash matches the manifest hash; user-modified stale files are kept, dropped from the manifest, and reported in keptModified. The rebuilt cache manifest carries forward provenance for non-bundle files so user content is never re-labeled 'overdeck'. copyDirectoryRecursive creates destination dirs lazily so empty source trees produce nothing. The CLI reports pruned/kept counts.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Removing removeLegacySkills070Sync() (subsumed but harmless defense in depth)
- A dry-run/plan surface for prunes (planSyncSync and SyncItem.status unchanged)
- Changing distribution or adoption semantics for non-stale files
- Resolving whether ~/.claude/rules/ should exist alongside CLAUDE.md rule folding
- Pruning hooks, bin scripts, context-layer renders, or any non-manifest-tracked content
- Deleting user-modified stale files under any flag (no --force delete)

autoDecisions.summary: Modified stale target files are kept and dropped from the manifest (become user-owned) rather than deleted
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue mandates leaving user-authored content untouched; deleting user-modified content is a one-way door, and dropping the entry makes the keep idempotent.

autoDecisions.summary: Rebuilt cache manifest carries forward old provenance for non-bundle files and labels never-manifested files 'user'
autoDecisions.rationale: buildManifestFromDirectory stamps everything 'overdeck'; without carry-forward, user cache files would be pruned on the next sync, violating the issue's own constraint.

autoDecisions.summary: Target pruning covers the rules/ prefix sourced from CACHE_RULES_DIR
autoDecisions.rationale: Stale bundled rules are the reported symptom (beads-dolt-authority.md); manifest provenance plus hash match makes pruning them safe while current rule entries are preserved.
Extending SyncItem.status and the plan display adds surface area the issue does not ask for; execute-path reporting gives operators the visibility they need.

items.title: Add pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync helper to src/lib/manifest.ts and extend SyncResult/MergeResult

narrative.Action: In src/lib/manifest.ts add `export interface PruneResult { pruned: string[]; keptModified: string[] }` and `export function pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync(targetBase: string, manifest: Manifest, currentSourceRelPaths: ReadonlySet<string>, opts?: { prefixes?: string[] }): PruneResult`. Semantics: iterate Object.entries(manifest.installed); skip entries where entry.source !== 'overdeck', where rel is in currentSourceRelPaths, or where opts.prefixes is given and no prefix matches rel. For remaining entries: if the target file is missing, removeManifestEntry and record rel in pruned; else if hashFileSync(target) === entry.hash, delete the file (rmSync force), removeManifestEntry, record pruned, then remove now-empty ancestor dirs walking up from the file's dirname while the dir exists, is empty, and is not targetBase; else (hash differs) keep the file, removeManifestEntry, record rel in keptModified. Also extend SyncResult in src/lib/sync.ts (~line 395) with `pruned: string[]; keptModified: string[]` and initialize both to [] in the two constructors (executeSyncSync at ~line 421, executeAgentSkillsSync in src/lib/harness-skill-sync.ts at ~line 46); extend MergeResult in src/lib/skills-merge.ts (~line 25) the same way with initialization in mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync. Write tests/unit/lib/manifest-prune.test.ts constructing a temp targetBase and Manifest by hand (no paths.js mock — the helper takes explicit args): prune on hash-match, entry-drop on missing file, keep+drop+report on hash-mismatch, skip non-overdeck source, skip unmanifested files, prefix filtering, empty-ancestor removal that stops at targetBase, and idempotency (second call prunes nothing).

items.title: Given a manifest entry with source 'overdeck' whose path is outside the source set and whose on-disk hash matches, pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync deletes the file, drops the entry, and returns the path in pruned
Given the same stale entry but a hash-mismatched file, the helper preserves the file, drops the entry, and returns the path in keptModified
The helper preserves both the file and the manifest entry for entries with a non-'overdeck' source, entries inside the source set, and entries excluded by the prefixes filter
After deleting a pruned file the helper removes now-empty ancestor directories but never removes targetBase itself, and a second call with the same inputs returns empty pruned/keptModified
SyncResult in src/lib/sync.ts and MergeResult in src/lib/skills-merge.ts expose pruned and keptModified string arrays initialized to empty in all constructors, and npm run typecheck passes
Prune stale cache entries and stop mirroring empty dirs in refreshCacheSync()

narrative.Action: In refreshCacheSync() (src/lib/sync.ts:228): (1) read the OLD cache manifest via readManifestSync(CACHE_MANIFEST) at function top before copying; (2) build the source set by unioning collectSourceFilesSync(SYNC_SOURCES.skills, 'skills/'), collectSourceFilesSync(SYNC_SOURCES.devSkills, 'skills/') when isDevMode(), collectSourceFilesSync(SYNC_SOURCES.agents, 'agent-definitions/'), and collectSourceFilesSync(SYNC_SOURCES.rules, 'rules/'); (3) after the existing copy loops, call pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync(join(SKILLS_DIR, '..'), oldManifest, sourceSet) and expose the result on RefreshCacheResult (src/lib/sync.ts:223) as `pruned: string[]; keptModified: string[]`; (4) after buildManifestFromDirectory (line 327), post-process the new manifest: for every entry whose rel is NOT in the source set, restore the old manifest entry with a fresh hashFileSync if one existed, otherwise set its source to 'user'; (5) in copyDirectoryRecursive (line 199) delete the upfront mkdirSync(dest) at line 202 and instead mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }) inside the entry.isFile() branch before copyFileSync; (6) in the skills and dev-skills loops (lines 241, 254), count a dir toward copied/total only when it contains at least one file. Write tests/unit/lib/sync-prune-cache.test.ts using the vi.mock('../../../src/lib/paths.js') + vi.hoisted temp-dir pattern from tests/unit/lib/sync-adopt-legacy.test.ts: stale skill dir and stale rule file recorded in the old cache manifest are pruned; an unmanifested cache file survives and is labeled 'user' in the rebuilt manifest; an old-manifest entry whose file was modified on disk survives with its label carried forward; an empty source skill dir creates no cache dir and is not counted; a second refreshCacheSync() prunes nothing.

items.title: Given cache files recorded in the old cache manifest with source 'overdeck' and absent from SYNC_SOURCES, refreshCacheSync deletes them from the cache and the rebuilt manifest contains no entry for them

Given a cache file with no old-manifest entry, refreshCacheSync preserves it and labels it 'user' in the rebuilt manifest; given an old-manifest entry whose file was modified, it preserves the file and carries the old label forward
Given an empty source skill directory, refreshCacheSync creates no directory for it in the cache and excludes it from the copied/total counts
Given an unchanged bundle, a second refreshCacheSync run returns empty pruned and keptModified lists
Prune stale entries from ~/.claude in executeSyncSync()

narrative.Action: In executeSyncSync() (src/lib/sync.ts:421), after the copy loop and before writeManifestSync (line 510): build the source set from the already-collected allFiles relativePaths PLUS collectSourceFilesSync(CACHE_RULES_DIR, 'rules/') (required so current rules/ manifest entries are not wrongly pruned — hazard H2), then call pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync(CLAUDE_DIR, manifest, sourceSet, { prefixes: ['skills/', 'agents/', 'rules/'] }) and append the results into result.pruned / result.keptModified (fields added by prune-helper). Write the executeSyncSync section of tests/unit/lib/sync-prune-target.test.ts (same paths.js mock pattern): manifest-tracked stale skills/old-skill/SKILL.md with matching hash is deleted, its entry dropped, and the now-empty skills/old-skill/ dir removed; the same file user-modified is kept, its entry dropped, and the path appears in keptModified; an unmanifested ~/.claude/skills/user-skill/ absent from the cache is untouched; a stale rules/beads-dolt-authority.md entry is pruned while a manifest entry for a rule still in CACHE_RULES_DIR is kept.

items.title: Given a manifest-tracked stale skill file in ~/.claude with matching hash, executeSyncSync deletes the file, drops the entry, removes the empty skill dir, and reports the path in pruned
Given the same stale entry with a user-modified file, executeSyncSync preserves the file, drops the entry, and reports the path in keptModified
executeSyncSync leaves unmanifested target files untouched and keeps manifest entries for rules still present in CACHE_RULES_DIR while pruning stale rules entries
Prune stale entries from ~/.agents/skills in executeAgentSkillsSync()

narrative.Action: In executeAgentSkillsSync() (src/lib/harness-skill-sync.ts:46), before writeManifestSync: build the source set by mapping collectSourceFilesSync(sourceSkillsDir, '') to `skills/<rel>` manifest keys, then call pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync(dirname(targetSkillsDir), manifest, sourceSet, { prefixes: ['skills/'] }) and append results into the function's SyncResult.pruned/keptModified. Add the executeAgentSkillsSync cases to tests/unit/lib/sync-prune-target.test.ts using the function's existing injectable targetSkillsDir/sourceSkillsDir parameters (no paths.js mock needed): stale manifest-tracked file deleted and reported, user-modified stale file kept and reported in keptModified, unmanifested file untouched.

items.title: Given a stale manifest-tracked file under the target skills dir with matching hash, executeAgentSkillsSync deletes it, drops the entry, and reports the path in pruned
Given a user-modified stale file, executeAgentSkillsSync preserves it, drops the entry, reports it in keptModified, and leaves unmanifested files untouched
Prune stale entries in mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync()

expected_outputs: skills-merge.test.ts passes including new prune cases

narrative.Action: In mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync() (src/lib/skills-merge.ts:67): build the source set from the three cache dirs using the same category mapping as the sources array at lines 87-91 (SKILLS_DIR → 'skills/', CACHE_AGENTS_DIR → 'agents/', CACHE_RULES_DIR → 'rules/'), then after the copy loop and before writeManifestSync (~line 135) call pruneStaleManifestEntriesSync(join(workspacePath, '.claude'), manifest, sourceSet, { prefixes: ['skills/', 'agents/', 'rules/'] }) and append results into the extended MergeResult.pruned/keptModified. Extend tests/unit/lib/skills-merge.test.ts (it already builds temp workspaces) with: stale manifest-tracked workspace file pruned and reported; user-modified stale file kept and reported in keptModified; unmanifested file untouched.

items.title: Given a stale manifest-tracked file in a workspace .claude dir with matching hash, mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync deletes it, drops the entry, and reports the path in pruned
Given a user-modified stale file or an unmanifested file, mergeSkillsIntoWorkspaceSync preserves it and reports only the modified one in keptModified
Report pruned and kept-modified counts in the pan sync CLI output

narrative.Action: In src/cli/commands/sync.ts: at the cache spinner summary (~lines 301-308) append, only when nonzero, `pruned N stale` / `kept N user-modified stale` fragments from the RefreshCacheResult fields; at the distribution spinner summary (~lines 316-360) do the same for executeSyncSync and executeAgentSkillsSync results. When any keptModified list is nonempty, print each kept path under a `Kept user-modified stale file(s):` line in chalk.dim, mirroring the conflict-list style at ~line 349. Do not change planSyncSync, SyncItem.status, or the --dry-run path. Verification: npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass; no new test file required (display-only change), but run npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/sync-prune-target.test.ts tests/unit/lib/sync-prune-cache.test.ts to confirm no regression in the result plumbing.

items.title: When a sync run prunes entries, the cache and distribution summaries print the pruned counts; when nothing is pruned, no prune fragment appears
When keptModified is nonempty, the CLI prints each kept path under a Kept user-modified stale file(s) heading
Document sync pruning in core-commands.mdx, skills.mdx, and the pan-sync skill

narrative.Action: Update three doc surfaces to state the new behavior: (1) cli/core-commands.mdx `## pan sync` section (line 31) — sync now prunes cache and target entries whose bundled source was removed, never deletes user-owned or user-modified files (user-modified stale files are reported instead), and does not propagate empty source dirs; (2) features/skills.mdx — add the same prune guarantee where the cache→harness sync flow is described; (3) sync-sources/skills/pan-sync/SKILL.md — update the behavior prose so agents know removed skills/rules disappear from harness dirs on the next sync. No flag changes, so scripts/lint-skills.sh should pass unchanged; run npm run lint to confirm.
